The full expression therefore has an affirmative old-text basis; the new English is project-created. whole_expression_assessment.strongest_contrary: The modern Missal deliberately reappoints a Gallican post-nomina as a Roman Collect, while the old source abbreviates the ending. A modern scholarly discussion quotes manuscript-style grammatical forms differing from the received prayer, raising the possibility of hidden modern normalization. Treating that diplomatic quotation, Mabillon’s edition and the current Missal as identical would overclaim source exactness and could conceal a substantive modern revision.

Even if they reflect early editorial normalization, they are visibly present in the independently old printed expression used here; no claim about exact manuscript spelling is needed. The full ending is independently evidenced and its assembly is explicit. The different appointment and conventional prescribed ending do not introduce unexplained modern petition wording or a new substantive clause arrangement.

findings.assessment: God of everlasting mercy retains the genitive characterization. Breaking the relative into direct address changes English syntax without changing God as the agent.
At the very recurrence of the paschal feast preserves in ipso ... recursu, including recurrence rather than merely a vague time in Easter.
Kindle the faith of the people consecrated to you correctly places sacratae tibi with plebis and retains God’s action upon their faith.

Increase the grace you have given retains the imperative and past gift; so that all may understand with worthy insight preserves the purpose and digna intelligentia without turning worthiness into a different subject.

By what washing they have been cleansed, by what Spirit they have been born anew, and by what blood they have been redeemed preserves each ablative instrument, passive action, parallel order and theological distinction.

The full Father-addressed conclusion retains Christ as Son, living and reigning with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, and the eternal ending. R. Amen is visibly a response, not an extra petition.
